items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: There was no wood block, Joe didn’t have a wood block, so Brubeck said, “Well what about the edge of the stage? It’s maple, let’s try that.”

ctx.x: Umm. That was a fortuitous little encounter. Didn’t they do that thing in seven also? “Unsquare Dance.”

“Unsquare [Square] Dance,” with the ticking sound which was done on the edge of a stage. They wanted a different sound and Joe was doing it on the rims, and they were experimenting. There was no wood block, Joe didn’t have a wood block, so Brubeck said, “Well what about the edge of the stage? It’s maple, let’s try that.” So Joe went down and it’s on the record, it’s the edge of the stage.
I like that recording. I think the liner notes say you can hear him chuckle at the end of it.
